messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed for service=router-api env=prod commit=6f2a9b3 canary=10% -> 21:13 UTC :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: @jun (oncall) paging: Canary health alert for router-api: missing telemetry for token-rate and kvcache-hit (threshold breach) :rotating_light:
jun (oncall): I’m on it. Repro steps? Any errors in canary pods?
sara (deploy): I rolled the canary earlier and saw no crash. Logs looked fine. We did change a tiny telemetry wrapper in the last commit (6f2a9b3) — it changed metric namespace.
mike (sre): Can we confirm metrics ingestion? grafana shows a sudden drop to 0 for metric `router.token_rate` starting at 21:14 UTC.
emma (eng-ml): That metric is used by autoscaler policy. If it's 0 the router moves traffic to fallback which explains increased tail latency for a small subset of requests.
jun (oncall): ok quick triage plan: 1) check canary pod logs 2) check prometheus scrape success 3) if we see schema change, revert patch or patch back metric name 4) alert CS for customer impact
sara (deploy): logs from canary pod (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T21:14:05Z INFO metrics: report {"name":"router.token_rate_v2","value":42}
2026-03-15T21:14:05Z INFO metrics: publish ok
```
We accidentally renamed to `router.token_rate_v2` in the helper.
mike (sre): Prom scrape shows 404 for /metrics on one canary replica between 21:14:10-21:15:00, but overall scrape ok. The exporter is still exposing `router.token_rate_v2` which the alerting rule doesn't match.
jun (oncall): So this is a telemetry schema change — autoscaler/alerts are still looking for `router.token_rate`. That's causing false-positive alert and a temporary routing fallback. Impact: small % of traffic saw higher latency while canary ratcheted down.
zach (cs): Any customer-facing errors? We saw 3 support tickets reporting slow responses around 21:15 UTC for accounts in EU region.
pm-olivia: Noted. Can you estimate number of requests affected and which customers?
emma (eng-ml): Looking at traces, ~0.6% of requests in EU over 21:14-21:18 hit fallback path. 95th latency increased from 120ms -> 890ms for those.
sara (deploy): Quick mitigation: two options — roll back commit 6f2a9b3 or hot-patch metrics to also emit old name. Smaller blast radius to patch helper to emit both metric names. I can push a one-line change to metrics wrapper and roll to canary in 3 mins.
jun (oncall): Sara, do patch. Mike, keep an eye on autoscaler. Emma, validate metric returns. Zach, prep CS blurb: short K/V not customer-facing outage but performance blip.
sara (deploy): Pushing patch now. Command: `git cherry-pick -x 7a9c3e5 && git commit -m "metrics: emit legacy name for router.token_rate"` then CI -> canary.
incident-bot: CI pipeline started for commit=3c9b1f4 (deploy user=sara) :gear:
sara (deploy): Canary rollout in progress 21:20 UTC.
mike (sre): Prometheus now receiving `router.token_rate` again on canary at 21:21:10. Alert cleared.
emma (eng-ml): Verified autoscaler sees sane values, fallback traffic dropped to baseline. Latency back to normal for subsequent requests.
jun (oncall): Good. Can we promote patch to prod? Any risk?
sara (deploy): Patch is additive (emits both names). Low risk. Promoting to prod now.
incident-bot: Deploy to prod started commit=3c9b1f4 env=prod :rocket:
pm-olivia: CS note draft: "Between 21:14-21:18 UTC a small percentage of EU requests experienced increased latency due to a telemetry metric rename during canary. We deployed a patch and restored normal performance by 21:22 UTC. No data loss."
zach (cs): Sending to affected customers now.
jun (oncall): Closing alert window. We'll collect telemetry over next 24h to ensure no regression. Assigning postmortem: owner=sara, due=2026-03-17. Root cause: missing backward compatibility in a telemetry rename. Action items: 1) Add pre-deploy check for metric name changes 2) Emit legacy metric for 2 deploy cycles by default when renaming 3) Improve canary watch runbook to include metric-schema validation 4) CS notify template update.
mike (sre): Adding a Grafana alert for drop-to-zero patterns that excludes expected schema migrations.
emma (eng-ml): I'll add a unit test to telemetry wrapper + update docs.
sara (deploy): Postmortem draft will include timeline, CI artifacts, and the single-line patch diff.
jun (oncall): Thanks all. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Closed canary deployment alert for router-api commit=6f2a9b3
